profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Borrowworks
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack software engineer with 7 years of professional experience in both building and maintaining enterprise web applications—primarily using .Net and React with Redux.

I have a passion for problem solving; I enjoy the creativity that is afforded to me in being able to take an abstract idea and then transform it into a concrete, functional reality. 

I've worked on teams that have built applications from the ground up; from end to end.

I have three years of experience working within an Agile, scrum based work environment.

I am proficient using Git and Azure DevOps for source control and application deployment.

I have experience building restful Web APIs and microservices using OData.

I have experience writing SQL queries, using T-SQL and SQL Server.

I have experience engineering SAML SSO using Duende Identity Server.

Personally, I have built and deployed numerous web applications using the MERN stack (Mongo DB, Express, React, Node). I have also built bots using JavaScript and Node, and mobile applications using React Native.
